atlases.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production game sprite atlas for IMMUNOFRONT, a charming premium 2D lane-defense game about blood cells. Create ONE square transparent PNG atlas, preferably 2048x2048, perfectly regular FOUR COLUMNS x FOUR ROWS, 16 isolated full-body sprites. Absolutely NO text, NO labels, NO frames, NO background, NO floor. Every cell contains exactly one character. Leave at least 12% transparent padding on each tile, no overlaps between tiles. All face RIGHT in three-quarter side view, camera and feet baseline consistent, strong clean dark plum outlines, polished hand-painted cartoon shading, bright jewel colors, expressive big eyes, compact rounded biological cell bodies with little hands and feet, mobile game readable silhouettes. These are anthropomorphic CELLS, not humans or soldiers.
COLUMNS across EVERY row: 1 ready/idle pose, 2 clear role-specific ACTION pose, 3 hurt/recoil pose keeping equipment, 4 cheerful victory pose keeping equipment. Consistent exact character identity and equipment across all four poses.
ROW 1: red blood cell / ERYTHROCYTE. Crimson biconcave disc cell with visible central depression, golden wrist cuffs, no bag and NO gun. Idle fists resting by waist. ACTION: power charging like an anime super-warrior, legs apart, fists clenched low beside hips, determined upward face, small golden energy particles streaming INWARD to body, golden flame aura and short electric arcs rising around the body. Keep the full aura within its tile and leave transparent padding. HURT grimace with arms braced. VICTORY fists lifted and restrained gold glow. Must remain a red disc cell, no human hair.
ROW 2: PLATELET. Small amber/golden irregular star-like cell, tiny teal eyes, thick shield made from interwoven luminous golden fibrin fibers and a miniature shield projector gauntlet. ACTION crouching brace, shield enlarged in FRONT on right, protect allies. Hurt shield up, victory shield raised.
ROW 3: NEUTROPHIL. Pearly ivory white round cell with visible three-lobed violet nucleus marking, purple gloves, holds ONE clearly visible compact fantasy rune BLASTER with chunky silver barrel and cyan glowing energy chamber. Ready aiming blaster to RIGHT. ACTION firing blaster to RIGHT with small cyan muzzle flash, two hands on weapon, determined face. Hurt recoils gripping weapon. Victory gun angled up, smiling.
ROW 4: MACROPHAGE. Larger stocky pale peach/ivory amoeboid white cell with lobed purple nucleus, sturdy little boots, carrying ONE heavy fantasy vacuum/plasma CANNON, brass rings and teal core, oversized open circular muzzle facing right. ACTION braced firing a short teal energy burst to RIGHT from cannon. Hurt bracing cannon. Victory cannon held proudly. Compact and friendly.
All sprites should have similar visual body height within each tile; weapon extends to right without touching tile edge. Transparent pixels between sprites. No extra characters, no words, no checkerboard painted into image. Genuine alpha transparency.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW transparent game sprite atlas matching the art style of the reference atlas: premium chibi biological cells, clean dark plum outlines, glossy painterly cartoon shading, ivory cell bodies, expressive large eyes, gold/teal fantasy equipment. The reference is STYLE ONLY; replace ALL characters with the new ones below.
ONE square transparent PNG atlas, preferably 2048x2048, perfectly regular FOUR COLUMNS x FOUR ROWS = exactly 16 full body cell characters. No text, labels, grid, background or ground. Each sprite STRICTLY stays inside its own tile with 14% empty padding on every side. Small muzzle flashes must stay in tile. All characters face RIGHT; consistent same-size body, camera and feet baseline across poses.
COLUMNS: 1 idle combat ready, 2 role-specific action, 3 hurt/recoil still holding equipment, 4 victory still holding equipment.
ROW 1: NATURAL KILLER. Pearly white compact spherical biological cell with turquoise rim and cyan nucleus marks, violet tiny gloves/boots, wears a tiny glowing cyan visor over expressive eyes, holds a fantasy crystal PULSE RIFLE with twin cyan rails and violet energy core pointing RIGHT. ACTION shoots a small sharp cyan-violet muzzle flare to right, braced stance. Friendly heroic rather than military.
ROW 2: CYTOTOXIC T. Ivory rounded lymphocyte with large visible deep-blue circular nucleus marking, cobalt forearm cuffs, tiny angular blue shoulder crystals, holds a long fantasy ARC CANNON with gold ring barrel and blue energy crystal, always aimed to right. ACTION intense short blue lightning muzzle burst to RIGHT and recoil. Distinct from row 1, heavier weapon, focused expression.
ROW 3: DENDRITIC. Ivory white cell with six short lavender dendrite extensions around its circular body (biological antenna-like arms), prominent violet nucleus spot. Carries a fantasy prism SCANNER STAFF in front, a teal gem at tip, tiny gold scanning monocle. ACTION projects a short translucent cyan scan fan from staff to right, investigative concentrated face. Not a gunfighter. Hurt shielding scanner, victory staff raised.
ROW 4: HELPER T. Ivory mint-tinted round lymphocyte with teal circular nucleus marking, mint tiny gloves, small gold-and-teal collar, holding a ornate fantasy SUPPORT SCEPTER with a floating jade orb, no gun. ACTION holds orb up and emits three concentric translucent mint buff rings around its own body, glowing gold particles. Hurt hugs scepter, victory raised orb cheerful.
All four characters remain recognizable biological cells with tiny arms and feet, not humanoid people. Full weapons and effects visible with blank transparent margins. GENUINE alpha transparency, not painted checkerboard. Consistent character identity per row.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create a NEW production game sprite atlas in the same polished chibi cartoon blood-cell art style as the reference. Reference is STYLE ONLY. All new subjects below. Genuinely transparent PNG, square, 2048x2048 if possible. EXACT 4 columns x 4 rows, 16 full-body sprites. CRITICAL: all sixteen sprites fit STRICTLY INSIDE equal grid tiles with generous empty transparent margins. Make sprite body only 50% of tile height and body+weapon+effect no more than 72% of tile width/height. Lots of whitespace between sprites. Do NOT enlarge characters to fill the sheet. No text, labels, frame lines, floor, shadow background, logos or extra objects. Rich dark plum outlines, ivory biology, vibrant gold/teal/cobalt accents, big expressive eyes, tiny hands and feet. Friendly biological cell heroes, not humans.
COLUMNS: 1 idle/ready, 2 role-specific action, 3 hurt/recoil, 4 victory. Same identity/equipment per row, same camera and body scale, all face RIGHT, consistent feet baseline.
ROW 1 B CELL: pearly white rounded lymphocyte with visible deep indigo round nucleus marking, little blue gloves/boots and gold wrist cuffs. Carries ornate compact fantasy ANTIBODY CROSSBOW-LAUNCHER: a gold-and-blue barrel with two sweeping forked arms and a clearly visible luminous Y-shaped antibody bolt. Idle aim to RIGHT. Action fires one small Y-shaped golden energy bolt to RIGHT with tiny cyan muzzle flash, fully inside tile. Hurt holds weapon close. Victory weapon raised a little.
ROW 2 MEMORY B: ivory pale lavender lymphocyte with darker indigo nucleus, tiny star badge and gold round eyepiece, holds a distinctive advanced fantasy twin-barrel ANTIBODY RIFLE with purple crystal battery and two gold barrels, little floating holographic star above rear chamber. Action fires a small violet-gold Y-shaped bolt to RIGHT, calm confident veteran face. Hurt squint while gripping rifle. Victory confident salute with one hand, rifle in other.
ROW 3 PLASMA: golden yellow translucent teardrop-shaped liquid mascot with teal eyes, tiny gold boots/gloves, no white cell body, no gun. Holds a healing fantasy lantern with a mint luminous liquid heart in a clear glass reservoir. Idle lantern carried. Action lifting lantern with a SMALL mint healing ring and droplets around body; kind smile. Hurt protect lantern; victory lantern lifted with three tiny mint sparkles. Keep effects close to body.
ROW 4 COMPLEMENT: small turquoise floating round biological protein mascot with six short rounded nubs, pearlescent green core, golden ring harness and tiny gold gauntlets. Carries fantasy arcane beam-projector gauntlets, no legs needed, friendly face. Idle hovering hands raised. Action projects a short turquoise-gold energy beam to RIGHT from one gauntlet, small effect. Hurt curls up behind arms. Victory hands raised with small gold star-like motes.
Strong readable silhouettes, consistent four-pose characters. All effect glows have real transparent surrounding pixels and NEVER reach tile borders.
